summary: Adds a discount_code field and an apply_discount method to Order. Adds order detail and discount redeem endpoints.

findings.title: Order detail readable by any logged-in user
findings.problem: order_detail looks up the order by primary key alone and never checks the owner. The redeem view filters by owner, but order_detail does not.
findings.consequence: Any logged-in user can walk order ids and read other customers' totals and discount codes.
findings.fix: Add owner=request.user to the get_object_or_404 lookup, as redeem already does.

findings.title: Decimal multiplied by float raises TypeError
findings.problem: total is a Decimal from a DecimalField. apply_discount multiplies it by the float 0.9, and Python raises TypeError for Decimal times float.
findings.consequence: Every redeem request with the WELCOME10 code returns a server error. No customer can ever get the discount.
findings.fix: Multiply by Decimal("0.9") and round the result to two decimal places.

findings.title: New model field has no migration
findings.problem: The change adds discount_code to Order but adds no migration. The only migration, 0001_initial, creates no discount_code column.
findings.consequence: Django selects discount_code in every Order query, so the database raises a missing-column error. The list, detail and redeem endpoints all fail.
findings.fix: Run makemigrations and commit the new migration that adds discount_code to Order.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled on a session-authenticated POST
findings.problem: redeem changes order state and authenticates the user with the session cookie. The csrf_exempt decorator turns off Django's CSRF check for this view.
findings.consequence: A third-party site can make a logged-in user's browser redeem a code on that user's orders. The impact is limited because the only effect is a discount.
findings.fix: Remove csrf_exempt and have clients send the CSRF token with the request.

findings.title: New discount and endpoint behaviour has no test
findings.problem: The repository has no tests. Nothing covers apply_discount, order_detail or redeem.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the Decimal crash and the missing migration before release.
findings.fix: Add tests for applying the discount once, rejecting other codes, and denying access to other users' orders.
